changelog:
Version 2.0.0 of agent-hospital introduces breaking changes:

- The command to initiate healing is now npx @agent-hospital/sidecar heal (was previously npx @agent-hospital/client heal).
- All instructions and documentation updated to reflect the change from "client" to "sidecar".
- No changes to features, supported frameworks, or repair actions.
summary: AI-powered diagnosis and repair for AI agents. Send your health data, get diagnosed, execute prescribed repairs, report back until healed.
